title_zh: 不勉强走黑暗展道，改在明亮展厅等候

scenario.label_zh: 改选不经过黑暗展道的参观方式
scenario.goal_zh: 说明对黑暗的顾虑并决定留在明亮展厅等候

context_zh: 两位朋友在博物馆遇到一段黑暗体验展道，其中一人不愿进入。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I don't dare go through that tunnel. I know it's only an exhibit, but I can't see the floor.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: The darkness is part of the display. We don't have to go through it.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: You were looking forward to it, though. I don't want to stop you.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: I can take a quick look on my own if you're comfortable waiting here.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I am. I'll stay in this bright gallery and look at the photographs.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.text: All right. I'll meet you by that bench in ten minutes, and we can visit the next room together.
